mapper.sql: s.StoryId, s.Slug, s.Title, s.CoverUrl, s.PublishStatus, s.CompletionStatus, s.AgeRating, s.ChapterCount, s.ViewCount, s.FollowCount, s.RatingAvg, s.RatingCount, s.LastChapterAt, s.UpdatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Chapter c WHERE c.StoryId = s.StoryId AND c.IsDeleted = 0 AND c.Status <> 'PUBLISHED') AS DraftChapterCount, g.GenreId AS Genre_GenreId, g.Name AS Genre_Name, g.Slug AS Genre_Slug
FROM dbo.Story s LEFT JOIN dbo.StoryGenre pg ON pg.StoryId = s.StoryId AND pg.IsPrimary = 1 LEFT JOIN dbo.Genre g ON g.GenreId = pg.GenreId
WHERE s.AuthorId = #{authorId} AND s.IsDeleted = 0 AND s.PublishStatus = #{status}
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY s.UpdatedAt DESC, s.StoryId DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT StoryId, AuthorId, Slug, Title, Description, CoverUrl, AgeRating, CompletionStatus, PublishStatus, HiddenReason, ChapterCount, WordCount, ViewCount, FollowCount, RatingAvg, RatingCount, LastChapterAt, PublishedAt, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt FROM dbo.Story WHERE StoryId = #{storyId} AND AuthorId = #{authorId} AND IsDeleted = 0
SELECT Slug FROM dbo.Story WHERE Slug = #{base} OR Slug LIKE #{likePattern}
mapper.insert: INSERT dbo.Story (AuthorId, Title, Slug, Description, CoverUrl, AgeRating, CompletionStatus) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{title}, #{slug}, #{description, jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{coverUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ageRating}, #{completionStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.Story SET UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE StoryId = #{storyId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Genre WHERE GenreId IN #{g}
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.Story SET PublishStatus = 'PUBLISHED', PublishedAt = COALESCE(PublishedAt, SYSUTCDATETIME()), UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE StoryId = #{storyId} AND AuthorId = #{authorId} AND IsDeleted = 0 AND PublishStatus = 'DRAFT' AND ChapterCount > 0
UPDATE dbo.Story SET PublishStatus = 'DRAFT', UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE StoryId = #{storyId} AND AuthorId = #{authorId} AND IsDeleted = 0 AND PublishStatus = 'PUBLISHED'
